As of mid-2025, Canada’s labour market is experiencing a deepening structural imbalance. National unemployment has edged up to 6.9% (June 2025, Statistics Canada), yet employers across high-demand sectors continue to report persistent hiring challenges. The key issue? A disconnect between the skills employers need and the qualifications job seekers offer. This is not a cyclical problem.
